name: claude-harness
description: Practice-layer plugins for Claude Code: intent discovery, memory, guardrails, fresh-context review, and lessons.

plugins.name: dev-harness
plugins.description: Set up and run any project the way experienced Claude Code users do: discover intent first, scaffold memory and guardrails per profile, review with a fresh-context skeptic, and turn mistakes into lessons.

plugins.name: dev-harness-perf
plugins.description: Performance work done like an experiment: repeated-run baseline with a noise threshold, profiler evidence before every change, one change at a time, kept only if it beats the noise and the tests still pass. Needs dev-harness.
